derivedFrom: game 域 12 条（逐条见 scenarios）
releaseScope: Architecture 3.1.0 step T-P7: one game pipeline with scenario selection replacing eleven shape-identical workflows. Each scenario carries its own gate declaration and output contract, copied from the workflow it stands for, so collapsing did not loosen any of them.

keptIndependent.reason: 四个小写阶段 intake/capacity/plan/review 与 worker=planner；两阶段骨架装不下，收拢会改写它的阶段语义（判据①禁止"为凑形状硬压"）

openDeferred: the default scenario carries no gate instance (each of the eleven named scenarios brings back the gate its own workflow had); the backbone stage list is the shared shape
SELFCHECK is present for every collapsed workflow except game-code-review, which removes it; the backbone keeps onFail=repair on EXECUTE because all eleven sources had it
the pipeline input schema is permissive (additionalProperties true) on purpose: the twelve source input contracts differ, and each scenario still answers to its own output schema
